protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers declared, depth 6, 128-bit radix store

budget.rule: W_total is TOTAL WORK: every executed step is charged at STEP_IR (the walk rows), whether it ends in a relation or in an abandoned trail; the only row outside them is the fresh trail start, charged ceil(S/L) x RESTART BY CONSTRUCTION because every trail is capped at L = 64 steps.  Nothing here is a probabilistic bound on a toy frequency.
budget.success_denominator: S_eff = S: the budget is stated in EXECUTED steps and every one of them is charged, so the success model uses S and the waste is inside the charge instead of being added to it
budget.withdrawn: v35 trap_abort_waste = ceil(4497*S/5040000) x (32*STEP_IR + RESTART): Markov does not turn an observed toy abort frequency into an upper bound, and the aborted window's steps were already charged in the walk rows (double charge).

detection.mechanism: the shipped dict28_wide_lookup hit; BOTH collision classes are accepted (within-trail and cross-trail), each hit is one pair and the classes partition the hits.  recovery is x = (q^k A1 - A2)/(D2 - q^k D1) with the Frobenius index k from G.shift(); the denominator vanishes only with probability 1/r, so a same-trail pair is USABLE -- v35's discard rested on the false identity 'same start => D2 - q^k D1 = 0'.
detection.kappa_source: evidence/arm36.json: an injected-collision arm for EACH class at the production lambda; the debit uses the worse class, not the pool

census_fidelity.why: trail >= guard ring (6) for guard stationarity; the partition series at fixed S carries the W-dependence

store_spec_to_code.shipped_structure: radix tree over the 128-bit slot: h = ceil(128/22) = 6 levels, node = 2^22 x 8 B = 33554432 B (<= SIZE_MAX); v35's two u64 levels are withdrawn

production_layout.rule: radix tree over the 128-bit slot: h = ceil(128/22) = 6 levels, node = 2^22 x 8 B = 33554432 B (<= SIZE_MAX); v35's two u64 levels are withdrawn
production_layout.lambda_definition: lambda_bucket = arrivals / heads (occupancy per bucket head)
production_layout.v34_withdrawn: 2^128 bucket heads / 2^130 node capacity: dict28_ws_init takes u64 nb and ws_bucket masks 64 bits, so neither is representable or addressable

store_spec_to_code.lambda_rule: lambda = S / 2^128: the radix store addresses the full 128-bit slot, so 2^128 buckets are instantiable at 32 MiB per node.  v35's 2^126 heads are withdrawn, and lambda 1.1262 are withdrawn (2^66 B calloc > SIZE_MAX).

measured_retention_at_production_lambda.delta_explanation: 1-P(Poisson(lambda)>=5) is the terminal-size limit for an insertion-only bucket; the shipped chain evicts during fill as well, so the measured loss is larger. Both are reported; the LOWER of the two is used.

measured_kappa_detect.definition: P(true cross-trail key collision is DETECTED) = P(the earlier record is resident and the shipped dict28_wide_lookup returns its reference at the later arrival). Injected-collision control: uniformly chosen earlier key replayed through the shipped lookup.

arithmetic.addressing_rule: the radix descent is INLINED into dict28_wide_lookup/insert (rd_leaf has no symbol at -O2); 4 x the loop-free span (596 / 1068 Ir) is below the censused per-call charges 959 / 1711 Ir, so per-access addressing is charged by those rows and the init row is nodes x 2^22

row_anchors.fp12_dense_mulmod: executed f12mul span x non-guard steps
row_anchors.fp12_guard_cyclo_sqr: executed cyclotomic-square span x guard steps
row_anchors.keys12_formation: span(d28_keys12_form) + 4 x span(d28_montmul_r), both read from the shipped object's disassembly; every loop <= 4 iterations, so 4x the loop-free span upper-bounds the executed count
row_anchors.scalar_coefficient_update: 2 x span(d28_montmul_r) x 4 -- the executed MAC implementation, NOT an Fp12 span divided by 72
row_anchors.store_addressing_radix: 2 x span(rd_leaf): the fixture descends h=3 levels, production h=6, so twice the executed descent covers the production one

bounds_table.bound_formula: one flag per record + the 8-byte trail id the v35 gate reads
<= PROBES = 4 (chain full triggers the shipped FIFO eviction)

bounds_table.source_constant: 6 key words + 2 ref words + 2 evicted words

bounds_table.array: radix node (one calloc per reached node)
bounds_table.bound_formula: 2^22 x 8 B per node, h = ceil(128/22) = 6 levels; the LARGEST single allocation in the store

bounds_table.source_constant: h levels x ceil(arrivals / (PROBES x 2^D28_DB)) leaves
bounds_table.bound_formula: ceil(S/(4*2^22)) x 6 nodes x 2^22 x 8 B

bounds_table.source_constant: sizeof(ws_node) = 33554432 B, one per live record
bounds_table.bound_formula: min(arrivals, capacity) = S nodes x 33554432 B

type_table.code_type: u64 bits field; dict28_ws_init rejects bits>128
u64 db (<=22: 2^22*8 B = 32 MiB <= SIZE_MAX); h=ceil(bits/db)
u128 (rd_leaf descends the full slot; no 64-bit mix)
u64 d28_ws_live (fixture); capacity = PROBES x heads
Python int (ledger) / u64 counter in the fixture

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W; exact integer test

success.rule: p_used = p5 x min(kappa_cross, kappa_within) lower 3-sigma; both classes are counted, so p5's pair count is now fully usable
